answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on various conditional generation datasets... RocStories... Paradetox... DialogueSum... QQP... machine translation... detoxification... keyword-based story generation...

answer_2.quote: Quality metrics: ... Perplexity (PPL)... MAUVE... SOME... LLM-c... Diversity Metrics: ... n-gram Vendi Score... SimCSE Vendi Score...

answer_3.quote: For Question Generation (QG), we employ the widely adopted GPT-as-a-Judge framework... We employ the GPT-4 model... pairwise evaluation... factors... coherence, grammatical correctness, semantic soundness, diversity

answer_4.quote: four integrated ph.d student annotators... evaluate the generated text based on two criteria: (1) semantic reflectiveness... (2) sentence completeness... diversity MOS evaluation... (1) condition's semantic reflectiveness, (2) sentence diversity
answer_4.guideline: Rate semantic reflectiveness (0-1) and sentence completeness (0-1); Diversity MOS: Score 1 (identical) to 5 (max diversity)
